caption:
The era of buying a South Indian DVD, translating it line-for-line, and calling it an Odia release is finally, mercifully over. 

Our audience has high-speed internet now; they’ve already watched the original on streaming before we can even print a remake poster. 

The projects making actual noise today are the ones that smell of our own soil, our own slang, and our own chaos. 

It’s a terrifying time for the copy-paste machinery, but it is the absolute best time to be an original writer in Odisha.
topic: The death of the copy-paste remake culture in Odisha
